policy.principle: Reuse public chess knowledge without pretending correlated donor views are independent evidence.
forbidden: claiming exact reproduction from weights alone
counting a derived Stockfish view of an Lc0 position as an independent raw sample
random-position train/test splitting when source game or shard identity is available
policy.split_rule: Split by original game/shard before teacher relabeling. Never let another view of the same source position cross train/validation/test boundaries.

datasets.source: Leela Chess Zero public training-data archive
datasets.license: ODbL-1.0; individual database contents under DbCL-1.0 per Lc0 open-data notice
datasets.format: Lc0 training chunks; modern lineage includes v6 records with policy/search/value metadata
datasets.selection_rules: Preserve source tar/chunk/game identity. Sample by shard/game and keep native policy/value targets untouched.
datasets.notes: This is the primary public raw corpus. Stockfish also trains NNUE networks from Lc0 data, so Stockfish relabels of these positions are additional views, not independent samples.

datasets.license: Underlying Lc0 database remains ODbL-1.0; nnue-pytorch tooling is GPL-3.0

lineage.origin: Lc0 evaluation data plus Stockfish training/teacher processing

datasets.selection_rules: Relabel a high-information subset of Lc0 positions. Do not duplicate-weight the same source position as a second independent sample.
datasets.notes: Stockfish 18 documents a reproducible workflow capable of using over 100B Lc0 evaluation positions. The exact historical 100B corpus is not treated as a separately published Stockfish archive.

datasets.license: distributed inside GPL-3.0 nnue-pytorch repository; no separate dataset license asserted
datasets.selection_rules: Smoke/testing only; never represent this ~1 MiB fixture as production training data.
datasets.notes: Pinned by immutable commit, expected byte length, and Git blob SHA.

datasets.selection_rules: Use compatible network with exact hash and engine/version provenance.
datasets.notes: Weights are not the complete raw corpora that produced them.

datasets.selection_rules: Pin commit; treat code license separately from data/model licenses.
datasets.notes: Trainer expects externally supplied compatible training data.

datasets.selection_rules: Use only explicitly published/licensed artifacts with provenance.
datasets.notes: Upstream reports 15B+ self-generated positions; do not assume the full historical raw corpus is published.

datasets.selection_rules: Use generator/trainer directly; do not infer availability of historical data.
datasets.notes: Upstream reports 20B+ self-play positions and progressive purging of older games; generator/trainer are more reproducible than the complete historical corpus.

datasets.selection_rules: Keep network license separate from current AGPL engine source.
datasets.notes: Treat weights separately from current AGPL engine source.

datasets.selection_rules: Keep experiment, engine, commit, search budget and source-position ancestry on every record.
datasets.notes: This grows over time and should increasingly dominate training as Leviathan matures.
